title: Andromeda before Photoshop
explanation:
# Andromeda Galaxy's True Face

This stunning portrait of Andromeda, our galaxy's nearest major neighbor, is actually a composite of 223 long exposures from a Portuguese garden observatory, meticulously cleaned of Earth-based visual clutter—airplane trails, satellite streaks, and sensor errors—to reveal what this distant spiral galaxy truly looks like through our atmosphere. By carefully removing these terrestrial artifacts while preserving the real galaxy, astronomers transformed hours of raw observations into an authentic glimpse of Andromeda's delicate structure, showing that the most honest depiction of the universe sometimes requires digital restoration rather than removal.
